description: The Fallout 76 perk card deck: each card, its ranks and the Fallout 4 perks that do the work.
x-help:
A perk card has up to several ranks. Each rank costs some SPECIAL points and is backed by a Fallout 4 perk that applies the effect while the card is equipped. Cards come from packs and from the starting deck.

To add a card, add a row under Cards, give it a SPECIAL stat and a cost for each rank, and point each rank at the perk it should grant. The editor shows each rank's perk name and description from your plugin.

Most other sections are bookkeeping that BACUP fills in while converting; you can leave them alone.
